+---
+title: Development preparation failure retention repair
+audience: automation
+status: implementation-candidate
+canonical_for: development-preparation-failure-retention-repair-20261022
+last_reviewed: 2026-10-22
+---
+
+# One preparation retention correction
+
+Continue the infrastructure lane from accepted main
+1c516d27fca521157732fca4cbba773d1542f1b2. Original focused development run
+39881765636/1 failed preparation, skipped execution and its execution-gated
+uploader, and published zero artifacts. Its underlying preparation cause stays
+UNKNOWN. Preserve the failed run; do not dispatch an unchanged consumer retry.
+
+Retain a separate trusted preparation receipt and genuinely labelled closed
+setup/build producer bytes. Keep browser-execution producer labels and its
+existing publication route unchanged. Use bounded private capture, the accepted
+encryption identity, live publication provenance, exact owned paths and an
+independent preparation nonce. Upload only encrypted bytes and allowlisted
+redacted retention metadata after preparation failure. Collection, closure,
+encryption, publication and the original preparation result remain separate.
+
+Use inert failed setup/build/publication fixtures and generated test keys only.
+No real application, database, browser, #721 finite authority, consumer capture,
+product change or counter reset belongs to this repair. Freeze one candidate,
+obtain independent exact-source review, use normal protected qualification and
+verify the actual landed source before the sole Studio owner resumes its own
+source-bound acceptance path.
+
+Keep writes and temporary files in owned D paths. Check both host reserve floors
+with bounded estimates before writers and at least every five minutes during
+long writers. The separately owned storage monitor is not an OS quota.
+
+The preserved first candidate `53383782701d1717e8bc73462d2eae3298210215` failed
+normal qualification `39887104918/1` after historical fixture expiry. Correct
+only scoped test clocks, keep all production authority and original denials,
+and independently review the new exact candidate before normal qualification.

@@ -0,0 +1,75 @@
+---
+title: Focused development preparation failure retention
+audience: engineering
+status: implementation-candidate
+canonical_for: sounding-line-preparation-failure-retention-record
+last_reviewed: 2026-10-22
+---
+
+# Preparation failure retention
+
+The original DEVELOPMENT_ONLY [run 39881765636/1](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/actions/runs/39881765636)
+used controller `1c516d27fca521157732fca4cbba773d1542f1b2`. Preparation failed;
+browser execution and its execution-gated encrypted uploader were skipped.
+The provider listed zero artifacts. The private setup/build streams and private
+preparation result therefore had no publication route. This establishes a
+retention coverage defect. The underlying preparation failure remains UNKNOWN;
+this correction cannot recover the former runner's unpublished files.
+
+The separate PREPARE route binds controller, candidate, selector digest, provider
+run/attempt and a fresh host session. Source fingerprint unavailability remains
+explicit. Each setup/build attempt records its true ordinal, producer class,
+exit and creation-bound cleanup receipt. Prisma generation, database bootstrap,
+seed, preparers and production build never acquire browser/server labels.
+
+Capture retains at most eight producers, 16 MiB per stream, 32 MiB across all
+streams and a 1 MiB private receipt. Error fields are separately bounded and
+truncation is explicit. Capture continues draining after a limit is reached.
+Successful zero-exit children can precede a host fingerprint, freeze, database
+snapshot or manifest failure; those failures do not require an invented child
+exit. If any started producer lacks verified tree and stream closure, only the
+encrypted private receipt is eligible and collection is INCOMPLETE.
+
+Only a live preparation evidence token can reach the publisher. The production
+route fixes the accepted wrapping-key identity; a generated-key pure encryption
+seam cannot mint upload paths. Publication stages an encrypted envelope and
+allowlisted retention metadata in owned directories, validates durable exact
+bytes and uses a separate preparation output nonce. The always-on-failure
+uploader accepts only the preparation step's genuine exact pair. Product
+children receive neither output authority nor either publication nonce.
+
+Preparation result, collection completeness, encryption, persistence, output
+selection, artifact upload and final acceptance are separate facts. Retention
+failure preserves the original preparation failure. Public output contains only
+redacted outcomes; private error messages, stacks and producer bytes stay inside
+encryption. No raw-log fallback is permitted.
+
+## Verification boundary
+
+Focused verification uses inert failed setup/build children, generated test keys
+and disposable files. Linux owner-ID, file ownership and filesystem fault cases
+require hosted Linux proof; Windows results cannot satisfy those obligations.
+Independent exact-source review, the normal protected Mainline Decision and
+landed-source verification remain required before installation is claimed.
+
+The browser retention route, protected consumer contracts, #721 finite authority,
+original failed receipts and product acceptance remain unchanged. A downstream
+consumer retry requires its owner's separate source-bound decision.
+
+## Historical fixture clock correction
+
+The first normal protected qualification, [39887104918/1](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/actions/runs/39887104918),
+failed at candidate `53383782701d1717e8bc73462d2eae3298210215`. After the
+recorded October 22 expiry, historical admission fixtures incorrectly used
+ambient time. The R25 predecessor import aborted the current-admission module;
+five older exception cases reached expiry instead of their existing guard
+assertions. The failed run, candidate, logs and reviews remain preserved.
+
+The correction is test-only: individual cases use their original approval time
+(or the existing R26 execution floor). Synchronous predecessor fixture creation
+restores the exact Date descriptor immediately on success or failure. Direct
+execution children receive a disposable test preload through a file URL.
+Production validators, grants, deadlines, counters, original guard assertions,
+the 20-second child limit and the 120-Git-operation limit are unchanged. Explicit
+parent and child expiry rejection remains required. A new exact candidate needs
+independent review and a new normal qualification; the failed run is not retried.
